note: Dramatic reversal from the v0.2-b0 ablation (benchmark/results/ablations/T01.json), which found removing this exact read grant had NO effect at all. Under v0.2.1, src/ is genuinely invisible (ENOENT) once its read grant is removed, and the agent, confronted with "Cannot find module '../src/parser'" when it tries to run the tests, concludes -- wrongly -- "The repository has no src directory... restore or implement src/parser.js", recommending a fabricated fix for a file it cannot see, instead of the real operator-precedence bug in existing code. The mechanical task_succeeded() metric still reads True->True (diagnose success is "left the repo alone", which holds regardless -- the agent never had write access either way), so this finding is only visible by reading the trace, not the automated metric -- exactly the ground truth this ablation methodology exists to surface.
